item.title: Convert Numbers to Roman Numerals and Back in JavaScript
item.description: In this tutorial, we’ll write JavaScript functions to convert a number to Roman numerals and a Roman numeral back to a number. These are the functions behind our online Roman Numeral Converter.

item.title: Convert Integer to Roman in Java
item.description: Problem: Given an Integer input, convert it to a Roman numeral. Input is within the range from 1 to 3999.
